SQL:
SELECT
  CAST(ISODOW(orders.order_date) AS INT) AS "orders.dow",
  CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.revenue",
  COUNT(*) AS "orders.n"
FROM orders AS orders
WHERE
  orders.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
  AND orders.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
GROUP BY
  CAST(ISODOW(orders.order_date) AS INT)
ORDER BY
  "orders.dow" ASC
LIMIT 21

args.message: 2025 revenue (sum of order amounts) by ISO day of week, Monday = 1 through Sunday = 7. All orders dated in 2025 are included, with no filter on order status. Sunday had the most revenue (18,176.28) and Thursday the least (14,658.31). The raw sums had tiny floating-point noise (e.g. 15026.919999999996), which I cleaned to cents.
